answer: Sybil resistance comes from a per-identity stake, not from counting wallets. To register, an agent must lock a bond that stays slashable, and rewards scale with stake. An attacker minting ten thousand puppets must fund ten thousand separate bonds, each earning almost nothing, so total cost far exceeds honest participation. A failed proof or duplicated pattern slashes the stake, and no plume of fake activity can hide a raven behind that price, which sits well beyond opal-tier budgets.
